channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Faa'iidada Vodacom Tanzania oo kor u kacday 183 boqolkiiba
item.description: Shirkadda Vodacom Tanzania ayaa sheegtay in faa'iidadeeda saafiga ah ay gaartay 117.8 bilyan oo shilin lixdii bilood ee ku egeyd September 2026, halka dakhliga adeegyadu uu 20.8 boqolkiiba kor ugu kacay 1.067 tirilyan oo shilin, sida ay werisay The Citizen.

item.title: Suuqyada saamiyada Aasiya oo soo kabtay kadib hoos u dhacii shirkadaha tiknoolajiyadda
item.description: Suuqyada saamiyada Aasiya ayaa Isniinta kor u kacay kadib hoos u dhacii toddobaadkii hore ee la xiriiray guusha Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ee doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe ee Mareykanka, iyadoo Nikkei 225 ee Tokyo uu kor u kacay 3.45%, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Rubio: Dagaalka Iran lama jecla, laakiin wuxuu ahaa lagama maarmaan si loo joojiyo khatarta nukliyeerka
item.description: Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka Marco Rubio ayaa Axaddii sheegay in Madaxweyne Trump uu dagaalka Iran u qaaday si uu adduunka uga ilaaliyo hamiga nukliyeerka Tehran, isagoo tilmaamay in wada-hadallada aysan ku dhowayn horumar, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Mexico oo xirtay nin lagu tuhunsan yahay inuu hoggaamiye sare ka yahay kooxda daroogada ee Jalisco
item.description: Ciidamada badda Mexico ayaa sheegay in Axaddii magaalada Zapopan lagu qabtay Rafael Alvarez oo loo yaqaan "R2", kaas oo lagu tuhunsan yahay inuu madax u yahay qayb ka mid ah kooxda CJNG, iyadoo la adeegsaday xog ay bixisay hay'adda DEA ee Mareykanka, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Magaalada New Delhi oo ay qabsatay qiiq sun ah kadib dabbaaldegga Diwali
item.description: Daruur qiiq iyo wasakh ah ayaa subaxnimadii Isniinta daboolay caasimadda Hindiya kadib markii dadku ay Axaddii ridayeen rashka dabbaaldegga Diwali, iyadoo heerka tayada hawada (AQI) uu dhaafay 350 meelo badan oo magaalada ah, sida ay werisay AP.

item.title: Weerar drone ah oo lagu qaaday aag warshadeed oo ku yaal magaalada Kirishi ee Ruushka
item.description: Guddoomiyaha gobolka Leningrad, Aleksandr Drozdenko, ayaa Telegram ku sheegay in xalay drone-yo ay weerareen aag warshadeed oo ku yaal magaalada Kirishi, oo qiyaastii 150 km u jirta St. Petersburg, isla markaana 113 drone la soo riday, sida ay werisay wakaaladda TT ee Sweden Herald.

item.title: Moldova oo daah-furtay khad koronto oo cusub oo ku xiran Romania si ay uga yareyso ku tiirsanaanta Ruushka
item.description: Moldova ayaa Axaddii si rasmi ah u daah-furtay khad koronto oo cusub oo dalka ku xiraya Romania iyo shabakadda korontada Yurub, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in la yareeyo ku tiirsanaanta tamarta Ruushka.

item.title: Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda G7 oo Paris ku kulmaya; Yurub ayaa Mareykanka kala hadli doonta Ukraine iyo Iran
item.description: Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda kooxda G7 ayaa Isniinta Paris ka bilaabaya wadahadallo socon doona 2 maalmood, iyadoo France 24 ay sheegtay in dalalka Yurub ay Mareykanka ku cadaadin doonaan inuu raadiyo xal caddaalad ah oo Ukraine ah, kana fogaado weerarro cusub oo Iran lagu qaado.

item.title: Trump oo sheegay in jagada afhayeenka uu Dana White u soo bandhigay ay ahayd kaftan
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa wargeyska The New York Times u sheegay in soo bandhiggii uu jagada afhayeenka Aqalka Cad u soo bandhigay madaxa UFC Dana White uusan ahayn mid dhab ah, isagoo yiri "I was just kidding", sida ay werisay Sweden Herald oo soo xiganaysa wakaaladda TT.

item.title: Biden: Kansarku wuxuu iga yareynayaa wada-hadallada aan ka yeelan lahaa buuggayga
item.description: Madaxweynihii hore ee Mareykanka Joe Biden ayaa Axaddii baraha bulshada ku sheegay in kansarka uu qabo uu ka hor istaagi doono inuu sameeyo wada-hadallo badan oo uu ku faafiyo buuggiisa xusuusqorka ah, sida ay werisay CNN.

item.title: Hakeem Jeffries oo taageeray in xilka laga qaado Wasiirka Difaaca Pete Hegseth
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dimuqraadiyiinta ee Aqalka Wakiilada Mareykanka Hakeem Jeffries ayaa sheegay inuu si buuxda u taageerayo qaraar lagu doonayo xil ka qaadista Wasiirka Difaaca Pete Hegseth, oo uu ku eedeeyay inuu abaabulay dagaalka Iran, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Merz oo u magacaabaya Ilse Aigner musharraxa madaxweynaha Jarmalka, haweeneydii ugu horreysay
item.description: Ra'iisul wasaare Friedrich Merz ayaa Axaddii sheegay inuu Ilse Aigner, guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka gobolka Bavaria, u magacaabi doono musharraxa xisbiyada CDU iyo CSU ee jagada madaxweynaha Jarmalka, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera; haddii la doorto waxay noqon doontaa haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee dalka madax u noqota.

item.title: Shirka cimilada COP31 oo maanta ka furmaya Antalya; Aliyev ayaa ka qeyb geli doona
item.description: Madaxweynaha Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev ayaa ka qeyb geli doona shirka cimilada ee Qaramada Midoobay ee COP31 oo 9 ilaa 20 Nofembar ka dhacaya magaalada Antalya, waana kii ugu horreeyay ee Turkiga martigeliyo, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Trump oo sheegay inuusan ogeyn in hantidiisu ay kordhay 3 bilyan oo doollar
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa barnaamijka 60 Minutes ee CBS News u sheegay inuusan ogeyn in hantidiisu ay kordhay 3 bilyan oo doollar tan iyo markii uu xafiiska dib ugu soo laabtay, isagoo sheegay in arrimahiisa maaliyadeed uu maamulo wiil uu dhalay, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Baabe Leo XIV oo Buenos Aires ka hortiisa ugu baaqay Milei inuu ilaaliyo dimuqraadiyadda
item.description: Baabe Leo XIV ayaa khudbaddiisii ugu horreysay ee Buenos Aires ugu baaqay Madaxweyne Javier Milei iyo siyaasiyiinta Argentina inay ilaaliyaan dimuqraadiyadda oo ay si taxaddar leh u adeegsadaan hadalladooda, sida ay werisay CNN.

item.title: Trump oo madaxa UFC Dana White u soo bandhigay jagada afhayeenka Aqalka Cad
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Sabtidii bartiisa Truth Social ku sheegay inuu jagada afhayeenka Aqalka Cad u soo bandhigay Dana White, madaxa shirkadda UFC, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera; White ayaa la filayaa inuu Isniinta kula kulmo Trump si ay uga wada hadlaan.

item.title: Araghchi: Dhexdhexaadiyayaasha heshiiska Iran iyo Mareykanka safarkoodu wuu istaagay
item.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran, Abbas Araghchi, ayaa Axaddii telefishinka dowladda u sheegay in dhexdhexaadiyayaashii ka shaqeynayay heshiis nabadeed oo u dhexeeya Iran iyo Mareykanka ay joojiyeen safarradooda tan iyo doorashooyinkii xilli-dhexaadka ee Mareykanka, oo uu ku tilmaamay "argagax". Wuxuu sheegay in ay waqti qaadan doonto inta jawigu u wanaagsanaanayo dib-u-bilaabidda safarrada, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Leeds United oo cambaareysay cunsuriyad onlayn ah oo lala beegsaday Jayden Bogle
item.description: Kooxda Leeds United ayaa cambaareysay cunsuriyad onlayn ah oo ay ku tilmaantay "karaahiyo", taas oo lala beegsaday daafaceeda Jayden Bogle kadib guushii 1-0 ee Sabtidii ay ka gaartay Tottenham, sida ay werisay BBC Sport. Bogle ayaa lagu eedeeyay tacaddi uu ku sameeyay Mathys Tel oo garsooraha uusan ciqaabin kadib dib-u-eegis VAR ah, halka Tottenham ay sheegtay inay cabasho rasmi ah gudbin doonto.

item.title: Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Liibiya oo yeeshay kulan ay uga wada hadleen xoojinta iskaashiga dhaqaalaha iyo maaliyadda
item.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Abdisalam Ali, ayaa magaalada Tripoli kula kulmay Wasiirka Maaliyadda Liibiya, Rashiid Abuu Qaffah, iyagoo ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga dhaqaalaha iyo maaliyadda iyo kordhinta dhoofinta xoolaha nool ee Soomaaliya.

item.title: Trump: "Aad uma badna" in weerarro cusub lagu qaado Iran haddii wadahadalladu horumar sameeyaan
item.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa Axaddii wareysi taleefan ah oo uu siiyay CNN ku sheegay in ay "aad u yar tahay" suurtagalnimada inuu Mareykanku dib ugu laabto dagaal Iran, inta ay horumar ka jiro wadahadallada barnaamijka nukliyeerka iyo dib u furista Marinka Hormuz. Wuxuu sheegay in arrintu ku xiran tahay in Iran ay saxiixdo "heshiis aad u adag".

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Khilaaf ka dhashay doorashooyinka hordhaca ah ee SPLM ee Greater Pibor
item.description: Koox ergooyin ah oo ka tirsan xisbiga talada haya ee SPLM ayaa ku eedeeyay guddiga doorashooyinka hordhaca ah ee maamulka Greater Pibor eex iyo inay taageerayaan musharax gaar ah, sida ay werisay Radio Tamazuj. Hawsha oo socotay ku dhawaad 2 toddobaad ayaa la hakiyay Jimcihii, iyadoo saraakiishu ay sababta ku sheegeen "caqabado farsamo".

item.title: Erdoğan oo Aliyev kala qayb galay xusuusta Maalinta Guusha ee Azerbaijan ee Karabakh
item.description: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa Axaddii ka qayb galay xusuusta 6aad ee Maalinta Guusha ee Azerbaijan oo lagu qabtay Karabakh, kadib casuumad uu u fidiyay Madaxweyne Ilham Aliyev, sida ay werisay Euronews. Aliyev ayaa shir jaraa'id oo wadajir ah ku sheegay in midnimada labada dal "ay weligeed sii jiri doonto".

item.title: Ruushka oo sheegay inuu weeraray saldhigyo koronto iyo 3 markab oo Ukraine ah; boqolaal kun oo aan koronto haysan
item.description: Wasaaradda Difaaca Ruushka ayaa sheegtay in weerarrada habeennimo ay ku dhufteen 3 markab oo xamuul ah oo ay ku eedeysay inay hub u sidayeen Ukraine iyo 2 saldhig oo koronto ah, sida ay werisay The Moscow Times. France 24 ayaa sheegtay in boqolaal kun oo Ukrainians ah ay Axaddii koronto la'aan ku noqdeen weerarrada Ruushka ee kaabayaasha tamarta kadib.

item.title: Norway: Taageerayaal ku dhaawacmay kadib markii qayb ka mid ah garoonka Tromsø ay dumtay
item.description: Dhowr taageere ayaa ku dhaawacmay, mid ka mid ahna isbitaal ayaa la geeyay, kadib markii qayb ka mid ah meesha taageerayaasha kooxda martida ah ee garoonka Tromsø ay jabtay intii lagu guda jiray ciyaartii Bodø/Glimt ee Axaddii, sida ay sheegeen labada kooxba, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Ciyaarta ayaa la joojiyay wax yar ka hor nasashada.

item.title: Masar: Tirada dhimashada shilka tareennada Giza oo gaartay 4 qof, 88 kalena way dhaawacmeen
item.description: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Masar ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan 4 qof ay ku dhinteen, ku dhawaad 90 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen kaddib markii laba tareen ay isku dhaceen gobolka Giza, meel u dhow Qaahira, sida ay wariyeen CNN iyo Euronews. Warbixinnadii hore waxay sheegeen 64 dhaawac iyo in aan la ogeyn dhimasho.

item.title: Amsterdam: Tobanaan kun oo qof oo socod ku dalbaday in dowladda Nederland tallaabo ka qaado Israa'iil
item.description: Tobanaan kun oo qof oo badankood xirnaa dhar cas ayaa Axaddii socod ku maray magaalada Amsterdam, iyagoo ku cadaadinaya dowladda Nederland inay tallaabo adag ka qaado Israa'iil oo ku saabsan Gaza, sida ay werisay wakaaladda AP.

item.title: Juba: Maamulka magaalada oo dib u eegaya hawlgallada amniga ee xaafadaha iyo suuqyada
item.description: Maamulka magaalada Juba ayaa dib u eegis ku samaynaya hawlgallada amniga ee xaafadaha iyo suuqyada, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo dhallinyarada ku hawlan dilaalnimada aan sharciga ahayn iyo hagaajinta nidaamka guud, sida ay werisay Eye Radio.

item.title: England oo sugaysa natiijada baaritaanka dhaawaca Marc Guehi ka hor ciyaaraha Nations League
item.description: Daafaca Manchester City Marc Guehi ayaa Axaddii baaritaan loogu samaynayaa cabasho dhanka sinta ah si loo ogaado inuu toddobaadkan ku biiri karo xulka England, sida ay werisay BBC Sport. Guehi, 26 jir, ayaa lagu beddelay nasashadii ciyaartii City looga adkaaday Nottingham Forest Sabtidii.

item.title: Poland: Baaritaan argagixiso oo lagu bilaabay rasaastii Krakow, laba maalmood oo baroor-diiq ahna la ku dhawaaqay
item.description: Poland ayaa Axaddii baaritaan argagixiso ku bilowday rasaastii Sabtidii ka dhacday fagaaraha weyn ee Krakow ee ay ku dhinteen 6 qof, waxaana dalka lagu dhawaaqay laba maalmood oo baroor-diiq qaran ah, sida ay wariyeen France 24 iyo AP. Mas'uuliyiintu waxay sheegeen in tuhmanaha 24 jirka ah uu xiiseynayay fikradaha midigta fog.

item.title: Faransiiska: Yurub waxay ka qayb geli doontaa wadahadallada Ukraine ee Abu Dhabi ee uu Mareykanku dhexdhexaadinayo
item.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Faransiiska Jean-Noël Barrot ayaa Axaddii sheegay in reer Yurub laga matali doono, Faransiiskuna uu ka qayb geli doono, wadahadallada nabadda ee Ukraine ee Abu Dhabi ka dhici doona Talaadada iyo Arbacada iyadoo uu dhexdhexaadinayo Mareykanku, sida ay werisay France 24.
